test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the largest tiger reserve park of India?

options.text: Nagarjunsagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve, Telangana & Andhra Pradesh

solution:
The correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **largest tiger reserve** in** India** is the **Nagarjunsagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve**. Located in the** Nallamala forest, **the reserve spreads over **five** districts, **Kurnool District, Prakasam District, Guntur District, Nalgonda District **and** Mahabub Nagar district.**
 
• **The tiger reserve** covers an area of **3,728 km2** **(1,439 sq mi)**.
 
• ​This reserve's main area is **1,200 km2** (**460 sq mi**). 
 
• There are several plateaus in the hill ranges, including **Amrabad, Srisailam, Peddacheruvu, Sivapuram,** and **Nekkanti**.
 
• **The southwest monsoon**, which is active from the second part of June to the end of September, brings rain to **Nagarjunasagar.**
 
• Over a course of **130 kilometres (81 miles),** the Krishna river carves a basin over **200 meters **(**660 feet**) deep.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Critical wildlife/tiger habitats (CWH) are designated as parts of National Parks and Sanctuaries that must be preserved inviolate for the purposes of wildlife protection under the Forest Rights Act of 2006.
 
• It is determined and declared by the Central Government through the Ministry of Environment and Forests following an open consultation procedure by an Expert Committee.
